items: 1 cup finely chopped mix of parsley, dill and mint

steps: Heat oil in a large pot over a medium high heat, add onions and cook, stirring often until deeply charred (10-12 minutes).
Add garlic and cook until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the chicken, lentils, turmeric and season with salt and pepper, toss together until coated.
Pour in 8 cups of water, turn heat to high and bring to a boil, then turn heat down to a rolling simmer.
Cook on a simmer until lentils have split and broth is golden mush and chicken is cooked through (20-25 minutes).
Using tongs, remove chicken thigh, let cool slightly then shred and return to the pot.
Add the chopped herbs (parsley, dill and mint) and more salt and pepper as necessary.
In a small bowl, combine yoghurt and lemon juice and season with salt.
Ladle soup into bowls, spoon over lemony yoghurt and enjoy with some bread.

notes: Serve with a soft-boiled egg or chopped and cooked veggies as you see fit!

recipe_info.title: Chicken and Red Lentil Soup With Lemony Yoghurt
recipe_info.intro: A hearty lentil soup to bring you back to life, an absolute classic from NYT, this can be extended by adding extra greens, a soft-boiled egg or some chili oil.
